list.text: As you push down, it turns a large gear inside, which causes a smaller gear to spin.
That smaller gear drives a coil of wire between magnets, and that motion creates an electrical current.
Turning just the motion of your hand into a quick burst of electricity, and when the lever reaches the bottom, it pushes a wedge into a metal plate, closing the circuit.
The electricity suddenly rushes into two contact points and through the wire, letting you detonate a building without batteries.
